## Fixed

- Keep the adjusted window height above the taskbar when switching applications after a size adjustment has started.
- Preserve separate buttons and stable ordering for overlapping independent windows and windows already minimized at startup, while retaining confirmed native-tab behavior.
- Preserve windows, cached handles and known tab identity during temporary window-enumeration failures.
- Recover application window-event subscriptions after temporary Accessibility failures without adding a polling timer.
- Reject outdated actions and delayed file-hover targets after a tab or process is replaced. Keep title-only updates actionable and preserve external window titles literally.
- Preserve manual application-group order across ProperWM restarts when window identifiers are reassigned, including startup and missing-window grace boundaries.
- Run blocking Accessibility geometry work outside the Swift cooperative executor and bound operation time. Safely restore owned intermediate sizes after timeouts or cancellation, including temporary permission uncertainty, while preserving manual window changes.
- Release obsolete observation metadata and remove unused policies, diagnostic state and duplicate cache-test logic.

## Verification

The complete 900-test suite and a separate 153-test constrained-executor run pass in CI. Tooling, localization, deployment checks, Apple Silicon Release packaging and WindowLab replay checks also pass. New regression tests reproduce the faulty behavior before each correction; independent follow-up review found no remaining confirmed defects in the corrected scope.
